verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs list glTF loading as a built-in feature, and meshes and scenes can be hot-reloaded. The pack says nothing about FBX or USD import, so only one of the three named formats is covered, and only by a single brief feature-list mention. Missing for 10: FBX import, USD import, in-depth docs on glTF import fidelity (materials, animations, hierarchies), independent hands-on evidence that imports are clean.

support.subject: As a technical artist, standard interchange formats — glTF, FBX, USD — import cleanly

citations.quote: Features: lights, shadows, cameras, meshes, textures, materials, gltf loading
You can currently hot-reload scenes, textures, and meshes
